logo.reason: No rights-safe logo source could be confirmed. The university's own domains (www.amity.edu, noida.amity.edu, including the dedicated /amity-university-logo brand page found via search) did not resolve from this research environment - both curl (TLS renegotiation failure / timeout) and a rendering browser returned empty responses on every attempt, so no official brand-asset page could be read. The only copy found on Wikimedia Commons (File:Old-amity-logo.png) is an outdated/unofficial upload with no clear own-work or free licence attached to the current mark, and the logo used in the Wikipedia infobox (File:Amity_University_logo.png) is tagged non-free fair-use on English Wikipedia, which is not reusable here. Aggregator/vector sites (Brandfetch, PNGEgg, PNGWing, freelogovectors, vectorseek) surfaced in search are explicitly excluded by the rights rules. Recommend a follow-up attempt from a network path that can reach amity.edu, or direct outreach to Amity's media/communications office.
